algorithm: Independent symmetric 3-by-3 Gram eigendecomposition in arbitrary precision only: G=Z.T*Z; deterministic cyclic Jacobi diagonalization of symmetric G; V accumulates rotations. This is not a binary64 normal-equation shortcut, Gram inversion or candidate kernel rewrite. At 100/160 digits squaring conditioning is resolved independently and precision convergence is mandatory.
convergence: In the SAME sweep require max(abs(offdiag G)) <= min(1e-50,10^(-digits+20))*max(1,normG) AND full eigen reconstruction max abs error <=1e-50*max(1,normG); otherwise continue until512; no convergence claim from offdiagonal alone.
cross_precision_decisions: identical mathematical rank, retained directions, eligibility; EVERY geometry certified, no subset-only pass
dimension: Oracle supports1<=n<=23; mathematical eligibility still requires n>=5,3controls,rank3. This permits certifying legitimate failclosed too-small leaveouts, not widening support.
input_conversion: Decimal.from_float(float(v)) exactly, then arbitrary-precision arithmetic; rational binary64 value preserved
precision_stability: Both internal certificates must pass; rank/retained/eligibility identical; singular/RMS errors <=1e-45*max(1,abs160); normalized error<=1e-40 for eligible projections. Any failure blocks oracle gate.
projection: beta=sum V_col*(dot(ZV_col,D)/(sigma^2)) for retained directions; high precision RD=D-Z*beta, exact frozen rank/cutoff/RMS gates
rationale: Fixed prospective1e-50 certificate and1e-45/1e-40 precision stability, vastly stricter than1e-7 production error; offdiag stopping conservatively stronger at100/160 and certificate checked in sameiteration.
rotation: tau=(Gqq-Gpp)/(2*Gpq); t=sign(tau)/(abs(tau)+sqrt(1+tau^2)); c=1/sqrt(1+t^2),s=c*t; Q=[[c,s],[-s,c]] in selected plane; G=Q.T*G*Q; V=V*Q; ascending row/column sums
sigma: sigma=norm(Z*V_col); stable descending sigma sort, original index tie break; sign chosen largest absolute ZV element positive, first row tie
